chapter_title: Digital Ad Tech & Campaign Delivery Ecosystem
learning_objective: Ad Operations menghubungkan media plan, platform/ad server, publisher, creative, tracking, verification, dan analytics. Tugas utamanya memastikan campaign dikonfigurasi, ditayangkan, dilacak, dan direkonsiliasi dengan benar—bukan menetapkan seluruh audience strategy atau budget allocation. Ekosistem dapat meliputi Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, DV360, CM360, retailer platforms, dan direct publisher placements. Scope kerja mengikuti platform yang dipakai klien.
mapped_learning_resources: CM360 Overview — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2709362 ; IAB Tech Lab Measurement standards (OM SDK/ECAPI) — https://iabtechlab.com/standards/measurement/
source_evidence: Google describes CM360 as an advertiser/agency ad-management product covering trafficking, Floodlight and reporting. IAB Tech Lab lists OM SDK for third-party viewability/verification on web video, apps and CTV, and ECAPI v1.0 (13 Jan 2026) for standardising event/conversion communication. These are selected components, not the complete cross-platform ecosystem.
material_gap: No single source proves the complete ecosystem across Meta, TikTok, DV360, retail platforms and direct publishers, including ownership, partner hand-offs and commercial RACI.
required_next_verification: Add first-party documentation for every platform and retailer actually taught; obtain Ad Ops lead review of account ownership, hand-offs and escalation RACI.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

chapter_title: Campaign Brief, Trafficking Sheet & Naming Taxonomy
learning_objective: Campaign brief dan trafficking sheet adalah single source of truth operasional. Setiap object perlu advertiser/client, campaign, platform/publisher, placement/ad set/line item, creative, format, URL, click tracker, pixel/event, targeting, flight, budget, owner, approval, dan status. Naming taxonomy harus memudahkan identifikasi sekaligus kompatibel dengan reporting; jangan menaruh data pribadi di parameter atau URL.
mapped_learning_resources: CM360 Trafficking workflow — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/3419088?hl=en ; CM360 Set up a campaign — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2838056?hl=en ; CM360 Placement tags — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2826636
source_evidence: CM360 trafficking workflow covers campaign operations and placement-tag hand-off. Campaign setup documents advertiser/campaign properties, schedules and default landing pages; placement documentation says each placement corresponds to a tag and can contain multiple ads. These are CM360-specific structures.
material_gap: CM360 object hierarchy does not define a universal cross-platform naming taxonomy or required trafficking-sheet fields for Meta/TikTok/retail/direct placements. Client privacy and URL governance are not specified here.
required_next_verification: Create a client-neutral cross-platform taxonomy/trafficking template and validate fields against current platform/retailer object models and privacy-safe URL rules.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Creative and placement specifications memastikan asset diterima dan dirender sesuai environment. Periksa dimensions, aspect ratio, file size, format, duration, codec, frame rate, audio, click URL, SSL, safe zone, HTML5, fallbacks, responsive behavior, and platform policy. Spec berubah; selalu cek halaman resmi platform/publisher dan tanggal. Asset approved secara brand belum tentu technically eligible.
mapped_learning_resources: TikTok In-Feed Auction Ads specs (updated June 2026) — https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/tiktok-auction-in-feed-ads?lang=id ; CM360 In-stream/VPAID ad and placement setup — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/3312873?hl=en ; CM360 Creative-placement assignments — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/3414002?hl=en
source_evidence: TikTok's Indonesian In-Feed Auction Ads help page is marked last updated June 2026 and lists Spark/Non-Spark video specifications. CM360 documentation separately covers creative-placement size and duration/orientation matching and in-stream/VPAID setup. It does not provide the full Meta, retail or publisher specification matrix.
material_gap: The six-placement matrix also includes Meta and retail sponsored content. The evidence does not cover every current Meta placement, retailer file limits, all publisher specs or all changing format requirements.
required_next_verification: Add dated Meta Ads Guide and retailer/publisher specifications. Record ratio, dimensions, duration, bitrate, file size/type, click URL, safe zone and last-verified date per placement.

learning_objective: Tagging dan tracking memiliki fungsi berbeda. Platform pixel/SDK/CAPI merekam events; UTM memberi label traffic; ad-server placement tag memanggil creative/delivery; click tracker merekam click redirect; impression tracker mengukur exposure; Floodlight mengukur activity di Campaign Manager 360. Ad Ops harus mengetahui siapa memasang, siapa memverifikasi, data apa yang dikirim, consent dependency, and deduplication.
mapped_learning_resources: GTM Preview and debug containers — https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/6107056?hl=en ; CM360 Test tags — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2826648?hl=en ; Meta Conversions API — https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api/ ; TikTok Events API — https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/getting-started-events-api?redirected=1 ; GTM Consent Mode — https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/14009635?hl=en
source_evidence: GTM preview/debug connects a test site to Tag Assistant and exposes fired/not-fired tags, trigger sequence and data values before publication. CM360 test-tag guidance checks tag export, rendering, click-through and rotation. Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API and GTM consent mode are platform-specific event/consent references.
material_gap: Documentation does not validate a real site/container, platform account, consent implementation or event deduplication. Cross-platform identifiers and data contracts require client-side test evidence.
required_next_verification: Run an end-to-end synthetic lab with GTM Preview, platform test events, consent granted/denied, transaction IDs, deduplication and network evidence; measurement-engineer review required.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

chapter_title: CM360 Campaign, Placement, Ad & Floodlight Setup
learning_objective: Ad-server setup seperti CM360 menyusun advertiser, campaign, site, placement, ad, creative, and trackers. Placement mewakili inventory slot dan menghasilkan tag; ad mengontrol delivery/rotation; creative merupakan asset. Floodlight activities memakai counting method, activity group, value, and conversion window. Implementasi harus konsisten dengan naming, click tags, publisher requirements, and reporting.
mapped_learning_resources: CM360 Set up a campaign — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2838056?hl=en ; CM360 Create placements — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2829205?hl=en ; CM360 Manage Floodlight details and conversions — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/13681097 ; CM360 Floodlight counting methods — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2823400?hl=en
source_evidence: CM360 campaign setup covers advertiser/campaign properties, dates, landing pages and conversion windows. Placement guidance establishes placement as an inventory location represented by a tag; Floodlight references explain configuration and Every, One per user, and One per session counting methods.
material_gap: CM360 docs do not validate an accessible account, client data layer, exact Floodlight config or publisher acceptance; counting choices depend on the real business event and implementation.
required_next_verification: Have a CM360 practitioner validate hierarchy, Floodlight counting/window choices, access roles, tag setup and client naming in a sandbox or permissioned demo.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Pre-launch QA adalah quality gate sebelum campaign live. Checklist harus mencakup object setup, budget, flight, targeting, creative rendering, URL, redirects, tags/events, consent, policy, exclusions, frequency, geo, language, conversion settings, publisher acceptance, and sign-off. Upload success tidak berarti siap launch. Severity levels membantu menentukan blocker, major issue, and minor issue.
mapped_learning_resources: CM360 Test tags — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2826648?hl=en ; CM360 Tagging issues and diagnostics — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2829774?hl=en ; GTM Preview and debug containers — https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/6107056?hl=en
source_evidence: CM360 test-tag guidance checks export completeness, browser serving, rendering, click-through and rotation; CM360 diagnostics enumerate invalid tag type, missing size/parameters, unresolved inventory and missing valid creatives. GTM preview/debug supports browser tag verification.
material_gap: No universal QA standard spans all platforms, publishers, placements, consent states and client policies. Actual go/no-go requires live asset, destination, tag, policy, budget and owner approvals.
required_next_verification: Pilot the 30-case checklist against one CM360 tag export, one platform pixel/event flow and one direct-publisher creative acceptance; record expected/actual results and go/no-go owner.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Live monitoring membandingkan planned dengan actual delivery dan memisahkan media issue dari tracking issue. Pantau spend, pacing, impressions, clicks, conversions, cost metrics, rejection, placement status, frequency, viewability/IVT, site errors, and reporting lag. Troubleshooting harus hirarkis: data signal, tag, creative, targeting, platform eligibility, inventory, budget/bid, and publisher—not langsung menaikkan spend.
mapped_learning_resources: CM360 Tagging issues and diagnostics — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2829774?hl=en ; Google Ad Manager Investigate report discrepancies — https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/6160380?hl=en ; GTM Server-side preview and debug — https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/tag-manager/server-side/debug
source_evidence: CM360 detects selected trafficking/tag errors; diagnostics also describe Floodlight transaction-ID and multi-source deduplication alerts. Google Ad Manager discrepancy guidance aligns dates, timezone, line-item scope and unfilled impressions first. GTM server preview inspects incoming requests, routing, outgoing calls and errors. GAM is a separate product, so this is an analogous diagnostic reference only.
material_gap: GAM discrepancy examples must not be treated as fixed CM360/social tolerances. Root-cause analysis requires campaign logs, client/site status, publisher confirmation and the contracted escalation SLA.
required_next_verification: Add an incident exercise with synthetic delivery, browser/site, server event, publisher and platform logs; set thresholds only from a contract/SLA or platform specification.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Platform discrepancy muncul karena definisi event, click/impression filtering, attribution window, view-through, timezone, cut-off, consent, deduplication, latency, and identity berbeda. Ad Ops tidak boleh langsung menyebut salah satu sistem rusak sebelum membandingkan apples-to-apples. Reconciliation harus menyamakan scope, unit, date, event definition, and eligibility.
mapped_learning_resources: Google Ad Manager Investigate report discrepancies — https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/6160380?hl=en ; CM360 How impressions and clicks are counted — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/6193740?hl=en ; IAB Tech Lab Measurement standards — https://iabtechlab.com/standards/measurement/ ; CM360 Floodlight counting methods — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2823400?hl=en
source_evidence: Google Ad Manager's discrepancy guidance aligns date range, timezone, line item/ad scope and unfilled-impression treatment. CM360 documents impression/click counting and filtering; IAB OM SDK/ECAPI cover specific verification/event-interoperability scopes. No universal cross-platform attribution method is claimed.
material_gap: Platforms can differ by unit, window, timezone, consent, dedupe and latency. No cross-platform data dictionary, universal tolerance percentage or attribution approval is established.
required_next_verification: Build synthetic reconciliation with explicit date/timezone, event map, attribution window, consent, dedupe key, latency and excluded counts; measurement/analytics SME to approve residual variance.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Billing reconciliation and process control menjaga kesesuaian booking, delivery, dan invoice. Ad Ops mengumpulkan IO, placement logs, rate, booked volume, billable basis, currency, tax, discount, bonus, makegood, platform fees, and proof. Finance controls perlu separation of duties, version history, access controls, and archive. Operational efficiency bukan berarti menghapus quality gates.
mapped_learning_resources: CM360 View and download invoices — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/13744493?hl=en ; CM360 Create/request billing reports — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/9999963?hl=en ; CM360 How billing works — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/15406732?hl=en ; Google Ad Manager Billing setup/invoice comparison — https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/6214526?hl=en
source_evidence: CM360 invoice help covers invoice number, amount, status, PO/account details, credits/disputes and downloads. Billing reports include campaign/account, currency, fee, PO, quantity and unit-price fields but do not show payment status. Billing profiles and contract terms vary by country; GAM is a distinct product.
material_gap: CM360/GAM platform invoices are not publisher IOs, agency invoices, retail-media statements or Indonesian tax approvals. Actual billable quantity, fees, credits, taxes and payment controls require transaction evidence.
required_next_verification: Add permissioned/redacted publisher IO, billing report, invoice, tax invoice and vendor bill; validate currency, tax, quantity, credits, PO and fees with finance.
reviewer_role: AI-assisted research desk review; independent human reviewer not assigned; SME approval open

learning_objective: Capstone Ad Operations menyatukan operation chain multi-platform: brief, trafficking, creative spec, tags, ad-server/platform setup, QA, go-live, monitoring, troubleshooting, discrepancy, billing, and documentation. Keberhasilan dinilai dari accuracy, traceability, risk control, and timely delivery—not creative strategy or budget optimization. Setiap contoh account/data harus berlabel SIMULATED dan tidak menyiratkan akses live.
mapped_learning_resources: CM360 Overview — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2709362 ; CM360 Trafficking workflow — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/3419088?hl=en ; CM360 Test tags — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2826648?hl=en ; GTM Preview and debug containers — https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/6107056?hl=en ; CM360 Billing reports — https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/9999963?hl=en ; IAB Tech Lab Measurement standards — https://iabtechlab.com/standards/measurement/

material_gap: The source map does not provide live platform access, client/publisher paperwork, approved SLA/tolerance, an independent technical reviewer or a tested learner capstone.
required_next_verification: Run integrated synthetic capstone with permissioned artifacts and require Ad Ops, measurement and finance reviewer approval of rubric and learner evidence boundaries.
